title: RAW: greedy CV syllabary with a bare-consonant prefix forbids redundant split vowel spellings
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED_ON_MANUSCRIPT. Complete invented phonemic writer uses18CV signs,3isolated-vowel signs and1bare-consonant prefix. Greedy CV fusion gives a canonical inverse obligation beyond ordinary27-entry prefix-code coverage: no bare-consonant code may be followed by an isolated-vowel sign in the same word. All signs remain abstract; no Voynich sound or meaning assignment.

design.source: Finite document of nonempty phoneme strings over C={p,t,k,m,n,s}, V={a,i,u}; spaces preserve source word boundaries. These nine labels are hypothetical sounds in a deliberately tiny teaching inventory, not an attested historical language or a plausible inventory established by fitting. No stress, tone, long-vowel distinction, other consonant or diacritic is silently omitted. A source with additional distinctions is outside this exact model.
design.physical_alphabet: 22distinct abstract written signs: one for each of18CV combinations, three separate Va,Vi,Vu signs and one H. Names such as pa or Va denote ONEsign each. One globally fixed bijection to a candidate22unit drawing inventory is an unassigned key; no extra glyph, implicit control or native assignment is provided.
writer: Scan each source word left to right. If current phoneme is a consonant followed immediately by a vowel, write their one CVsign and advance two phonemes.

If current phoneme is a consonant not followed by a vowel, write H then its Ca sign and advance one phoneme. Ca here is merely a reusable explicit consonant selector; no a sound is emitted in this two-sign branch.
If current phoneme is a vowel, write its isolated Vsign and advance one phoneme.
Preserve each source word space. No choice, context lexicon, hidden mode, additional pass, null sign or reset.
design.reader: Scan written signs. Any non-H sign has its fixed CV or V value. H consumes the following sign, which must be one of the six Ca signs, and emits that consonant alone. Reject terminal H or any other H follower. Re-encode the recovered phoneme word and require exact equality to enforce canonical CV fusion. Document word boundaries are retained.
design.proof: The21singleton codes and six H+Ca codes form a prefix-free27entry alphabet. Decoding is unique. The only extra canonicality restriction is that a decoded bare-C token may not be immediately followed by a Vtoken: those phonemes would have been greedily fused. Every other adjacent token pattern is already the greedy decomposition.
design.falsifier: For any frozen global key, require ordinary prefix parse and absence of H F V anywhere within one complete written group, where F is one of the six Ca signs and V one of three isolated-vowel signs. A single retained occurrence of such a three-sign sequence contradicts that key even if ordinary prefix-code coverage succeeds. Also retain no terminal/standalone H and no H follower outside the sixCa set. Source inventory and actual key are still unbound; no native census selected.
design.paid_cost: Learner memorizes21syllabic/vowel signs and one H rule; consonant clusters and word-final consonants cost two signs each. Reader needs one sign of lookahead. All source phonemes are recovered, including hiatus and repeated vowels. No whole-word dictionary.

design.status_and_limits: A source-free complete writer, NOTan established phonetic interpretation. No identified historical source has this sixconsonant/threevowel inventory. Its severe inventory and bareconsonant-rarity obligations may make it useless; do not expand theinventory after failure. No nativekey, statisticalfit, semanticinterpretation or translation.

design.translation_decision_note: A native canonicality failure would exclude this exact invented sixC/threeV writer only. A pass would leave unassigned phonemes and language, so it would not by itself advance a reading. Therefore no native triple census is recommended now: first an independently justified actual source phoneme/word contract must make this exact inventory and sparse bare-consonant use relevant. With such a source, failure would stop its decoder and survival would only authorize a separately fixed source-word fit; without it both outcomes leave translation status unchanged. The current deliverable is the full RAW algorithm and its distinct falsifier, not an executed or selected experiment.
